what: On hero load, after .2s an accent-color veil (.8) lifts over 1s and the ring loader in the center fades with it. The background photo very slowly scales up to 1.14 over 14s, and the large lettering graphic comes into focus from 30px blur and 10% left over 2s. The one-line text enters from 30px right after 1.2s over 1s (curve is CSS ease)

options.dur: Duration for the veil or loader to lift (sec), default 1 — shorten it for screens opened often, like apps
options.scale: End scale the photo grows to, default 1.14 — 1 means no growth
options.shift: Distance the large text travels in (%), default 10 — 0 makes it sharpen in place
options.slide: Distance a single line of text travels in (px), default 30
options.slideAt: One-line text start (seconds, from act start), default 1.2
options.ease: Curve in the ”0.25,0.1,0.25,1” form or a GSAP name, default CSS ease
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Curtain (child) — empty div covering the whole board
options.[data-fx-part=blur-in]: Large-type graphic fading in from blur (children, selection, multiple)
options.[data-fx-part=slide-in]: One line of text entering late from the side (child, optional, multiple)

use:
Large text

One-line text

from.where: index.html .sh-hero (Hero navy curtain · ring loader · photo zoom · large vertical text)
